about.heading: Building real-world systems that matter
paragraphs: I'm a full stack developer based in **Nairobi, Kenya**, currently at **Oracom Group**, where I design, build, deploy and maintain enterprise systems end to end — backend logic, frontend, database architecture, servers, security and performance.

I've delivered **8 production platforms across 6 business domains** — ERP, finance, e-commerce, media, education and investments. I specialise in replacing third-party customised software with **fully owned, automated systems** that cut recurring costs and run faster.
I also build multi-tenant **SaaS products** — a WhatsApp ordering platform, a hospital management system, a 17-module school ERP and a real-time property management platform.

Hardened servers and optimised infrastructure, achieving 99.5% uptime across all production platforms
